analysis.session_summary: Friday-to-Monday tape was dominated by Iran headline whipsaw: Trump opposed a ceasefire, then US officials said positive intermediary talks continue, while Iran officials were pessimistic. Brent rallied 1.769%, USD/MXN +0.870%, USD/ZAR +0.627%, and SPX fell 0.409%, but G10 reaction was uneven. GBP and NZD led with strengths of +0.234% and +0.230% and closed at their best, while CHF was weakest at -0.342%; EUR/USD fell 20.7 pips with Lagarde's reaction muted inside the noise floor. No local macro catalyst explains the moves, leaving the tape flow-driven.

themes.evidence: Trump opposes Iran ceasefire, WSJ reports; US Official positive intermediaries; Iran officials pessimistic. Brent/USD +1.769%, USD/MXN +0.87%, USD/ZAR +0.627%.

CHF -0.342% weakest, EUR -0.115%; USD/CHF +34.1 pips, EUR/CHF +21.6 pips.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD chopped through a 47.6-pip range, with four alternating legs and no confident catalyst; the only measurable influence was Lagarde's muted -7.9-pip reaction, leaving the close down 20.7 pips driven mainly by EUR weakness.

polarity_reads.read: The measured reaction was muted: EUR basket moved -0.028% inside the noise floor; top mover EUR/GBP -5.7 pips (-4.99 sigma) likely reflected GBP strength, not a Lagarde surprise. Implies no ECB repricing; EUR weakness is flow-driven.

scenarios.name: RBA expected hike and hawkish tone keep high-beta bid
scenarios.thesis: RBA delivers 4.60% cash rate and/or hawkish statement, extending AUD recovery from its -0.23% trough and supporting NZD/GBP high-beta longs.
scenarios.invalidation: A dovish RBA or negative Iran headline reverses AUD/NZD.

pair_paths.rationale: AUD selling was rejected and recovered 89%; hawkish RBA would resume upside within its 32.5-pip range.
NZD closed at its best with no catalyst; high-beta flow can extend within its 38.1-pip range.
EUR has no strong driver; may stay rangebound while AUD/NZD outperform.

scenarios.name: Soft US data fades the dollar
scenarios.thesis: Consumer confidence and JOLTS undershoot, reinforcing dollar softness after its modest +0.067% close, lifting EUR/GBP while keeping risk tone stable.
triggers: US yields slip and DXY breaks 100.868
scenarios.invalidation: Strong US data or hawkish Fed speak revives dollar.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR weak but oversold; a dollar fade can reverse part of the 20.7-pip decline within its 47.6-pip range.
GBP already led strong; dollar softness would extend the 22.3-pip gain within its 60.1-pip range.
USD softness and flat JPY can push USD/JPY lower within its wide 134.1-pip range.

scenarios.name: Iran negative headline reignites haven bid
scenarios.thesis: US/Iran talks deteriorate, oil spikes further, and risk assets fall, reversing some CHF weakness but also pressuring EUR and high-beta currencies.
scenarios.invalidation: A confirmed Iran deal or positive US official statement calms markets.

pair_paths.rationale: Risk-off typically sends EUR/USD lower; its recent range is 47.6 pips.
CHF safe-haven demand would reverse part of its -0.342% weakness; USD/CHF range 53.8 pips.
JPY haven demand can drag USD/JPY despite USD strength; its range is 134.1 pips.
